da-non-sequitur.evidence: CRITICAL: S↔L: the ref resolves to the library file lean/QOU/BraidKnot/eigenvalue_product_expansion.lean:45. There `lambdaSym` is *defined* as the closed form (l.37-40) and the theorem restates the definition (claimed value taken as a definition, a tautology). The log expansion is not in the library at all. The sibling .lean differs: it proves only `crossing_exponent` and `four_term_expansion` (lean:70-73), a ring identity in free reals with ℓ, ℓ₂ and T not linked to q, Z, N. The ℝ is gratuitous. S↔P: **the statement is false as written.** md:8 defines T = |Z−N|/2 (unsigned), but the terms ℓ·T·A − ℓ·T come from q^{(Z−N)(A−1)/2}, which needs the signed T = (Z−N)/2 that the prf uses (prf:60, "signed isospin"). Counterexample (³H, Z=1, N=2): ln Λ = −ℓ + 2ℓ₂, but the md formula gives +ℓ + 2ℓ₂. At q = 1.10998 these are −0.09347 and +0.11521; the exact difference is 2·ln q ≠ 0. They agree only for Z ≥ N. The prf also says (prf:30-33) that the factorisation holds only in the δ = 0 convention, which the statement omits.

trap-nonspeakable.notes: RIGOR findings (reported, not fixed - math-adjacent): (1) SS7a CONVENTION VIOLATION - the Hecke generator is written T: 'each crossing c.T_g + d.I on the diagonal generator T_1 = diag(q, -q^{-1})'. AGENTS.md SS7a requires sigma_i, never T. Proposed: T_g -> sigma, T_1 -> sigma_1. (2) T-SIGN INCONSISTENCY with the statement block: this proof defines T = (Z-N)/2 and calls it 'signed isospin', but prop:eigenvalue-product-expansion defines T = |Z-N|/2; the term +l.T.(A-1) then has the wrong sign for every neutron-rich nucleus (N > Z). The signed definition is the correct one (n_pp - n_nn = (Z-N)(A-1)/2 verified). (3) NUMERICS VERIFIED: the eigenvalue table is exact with h = q - q^{-1} (q-h = q^{-1}; q-h/2 = [2]/2; -q^{-1}-h = -q; -q^{-1}-h/2 = -[2]/2), n_pp-n_nn = (Z-N)(A-1)/2 exact, ZN = A^2/4 - T^2 exact, and sum_{j=0}^{c} q^{c-2j} = [c+1]_q exact. Quoted [7]_q ~ 7.63 and [5]_q ~ 5.22 recomputed at 40 dps: 7.62534 and 5.22044 at BOTH the proton pin 1.1099785827513808 and the muon pin 1.10997859555733471 (identical to 6 s.f.), so both round correctly. (4) 'Verified ... to machine precision' is a float64 formulation; per the NO-FLOAT64 discipline prefer 'agrees to the limit of the arithmetic used' or state the dps.
